title: The Last Tree on Earth
logline: A centuries-old tree witnesses the destruction of its forest home and the eventual restoration by a group of determined children.
theme: Hope and Resilience in the Face of Environmental Degradation

characters.name: Methuselah
characters.one_line_description: A wise and ancient tree that has seen the rise and fall of its forest home

characters.name: Lily
characters.one_line_description: A determined and passionate young girl who leads the effort to restore the forest

characters.name: Dr. Patel
characters.one_line_description: A knowledgeable scientist who guides the children in their reforestation efforts

scenes.title: The Thriving Forest
scenes.summary: The forest is full of life, with animals playing and trees swaying in the wind

scenes.title: Deforestation Begins
scenes.summary: Humans start cutting down trees, and the forest begins to shrink
scenes.setting: The same forest, now with logging equipment

scenes.title: The Last Tree Standing
scenes.summary: Methuselah is the last tree left, surrounded by a barren landscape

scenes.title: The Children's Discovery
scenes.summary: Lily and her friends stumble upon Methuselah and learn about the forest's history
scenes.setting: The same desolate area, with the children exploring

scenes.title: The Restoration Begins
scenes.summary: The children, guided by Dr. Patel, start planting new trees
scenes.setting: The desolate area, now with the children planting trees

scenes.title: The Forest's Renewal
scenes.summary: The forest starts to regrow, with new trees and animals returning
scenes.setting: The same area, now with a renewed forest

scenes.title: A New Generation
scenes.summary: The children, now grown, return to the forest with their own children, symbolizing a new beginning
scenes.setting: The renewed forest, with the children and their families

scenes.title: The Legacy of Methuselah
scenes.summary: Methuselah stands tall, a symbol of hope and resilience, as the camera pans out to show the thriving forest
scenes.setting: The renewed forest, with Methuselah in the center

scenes.title: The Future of the Forest
scenes.summary: The camera continues to pan out, showing the forest as a part of a larger ecosystem, with the sound of children's laughter and birds chirping
scenes.setting: The forest, with the surrounding landscape

source_idea: Title: 'The Last Tree on Earth'. A centuries-old tree watches a thriving forest slowly disappear due to human activity. Animals lose their homes, seasons change, and nature fades. Years later, a group of children begins restoring the forest by planting new trees, bringing life back and ending the story with hope.
